identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Cemiplimab in Adults With Cervical Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-Label, Randomized, Phase 3 Clinical Trial of REGN2810 Versus Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy in Recurrent or Metastatic Cervical Carcinoma

interventions.name: Investigator Choice (IC) Chemotherapy
interventions.description:
IC chemotherapy options include:

1. Antifolate: Pemetrexed
2. Topoisomerase 1 inhibitor: Topotecan or Irinotecan
3. Nucleoside analogue: Gemcitabine
4. Vinca alkaloid: Vinorelbine

The only chemotherapy treatments allowed in the control arm are any of the 5 drugs that are listed as IC options above.
